title: Motorcycle Body Longitudinal In-Plane
text: Longitudinal in-plane motorcycle vehicle motion, 15 inputs, 7 outputs; {Suspension type} sets the type of suspension, {External forces} sets the fExt input port, {External moments} sets the mExt input port, {External front wheel moment} sets the mWhlF input port, {External rear wheel moment} sets the mWhlR input port, {Grade angle} sets the grade input port, {Wind velocity} sets the windXYZ input port, {Ambient temperature} sets the temp input port, {Center of mass location, FrmCmPxz} sets the frame location, {Mass, FrmMass} sets the frame mass, {Mass moment of inertia, FrmIyy} sets the frame inertia, {Length, FrmLen} sets the frame length, {Center of mass location, RdrCmPxz} sets the rider location, {Mass, RdrMass} sets the rider mass, {Mass moment of inertia, RdrIyy} sets the rider inertia, {Position, FrkUpCmPxz} sets the upper fork location, {Mass, FrkUpMass} sets the upper fork mass, {Mass moment of inertia, FrkUpIyy} sets the upper fork inertia, {Offset, FrkOfs} sets the upper fork offset, {Position, FrkLwCmPxz} sets the lower fork location, {Mass, FrkLwMass} sets the lower fork mass, {Mass moment of inertia, FrkLwIyy} sets the lower fork inertia, {Position, ArmRrCmPxz} sets the rear arm location, {Mass, ArmRrMass} sets the rear arm mass, {Mass moment of inertia, ArmRrIyy} sets the rear arm inertia, {Length, ArmRrLen} sets the rear arm length, {Mass, WhlFrMass} sets the front wheel mass, {Radius, WhlFrR} sets the front wheel radius, {Mass, WhlRrMass} sets the rear wheel mass, {Radius, WhlRrR} sets the rear wheel radius, {Stiffness, SuspFrK} sets the front suspension stiffness 25e3, {Damping, SuspFrC} sets the front suspension damping, {Equilibrium length, FrkLwL0} sets the front suspension equilibrium length, {Stiffness, SuspRrK} sets the rear arm suspension stiffness, {Damping, SuspRrC} sets the rear arm suspension damping, {Equilibrium angle, ShkRrAng0} sets the rear suspension equilibrium angle, {Longitudinal drag area, Af} sets the area, {Longitudinal drag coefficient, Cd} sets the drag .2, {Longitudinal lift coefficient, Cl} sets the lift .1, {Longitudinal drag pitch moment, Cpm} sets the pitch drag .1, {Pitch moment length, Lcpm} sets the pitch drag, {Gravitational acceleration, g} sets the gravity, {Absolute air pressure, Pabs} sets the pressure, {Air temperature, Tair} sets the ambient air temperature, {Rear contact patch longitudinal coordinate, CpRrX0} sets the longitudinal coordinate, {Rear contact patch vertical coordinate, CpRrZ0} sets the vertical coordinate, {Pitch angle of rear arm, ArmRrAng0} sets the rear arm angle, {Pitch angle of main frame, FrmAng0} sets the angle length, {Fork length, FrkFrL0}, {Longitudinal velocity of rear contact patch}, {Vertical velocity of rear contact patch, CpRrVz0}, {Pitch rate of rear arm, ArmRrAngV0}, {Pitch rate of main frame, FrmAngV0}, {Lower fork deformation velocity, FrkLwV0} sets the deformation velocity, {Longitudinal offset, longOff}, {Lateral offset, latOff}, {Vertical offset, vertOff}, {Roll offset, pitchOff}, {Pitch offset, pitchOff} and {Yaw offset, pitchOff}. Values come from the instance.
